arStrings.szText: {c_important}Inferno's{/c} Burning duration is increased to {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} seconds. Enemies killed by {c_important}Inferno{/c} explode, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_EXPLOSION_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Inferno{/c} triggers {u}{c_important}Meteorites{/c}{/u} that deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_METEORITE_TOOLTIP}{/c} to enemies and Immobilize them for {c_number}[SF_22|1|]{/c} second.
{c_important}Inferno{/c} now forms around you and follows you, healing you for {c_number}[(SF_26 / SF_28) * 100 |%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life per second.
{c_important}Inferno{/c} continuously pulls enemies towards the center.
{c_important}Inferno's{/c} Cooldown is reduced to {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} seconds, but it now also costs {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} Mana.

{c_important}Inferno's{/c} Burning damage is now converted to direct Fire damage, allowing it to Critically Strike. 

{c_important}Inferno{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_25 * 100 |%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage.
